thread:
Sam: quick callout after the 03:00 deploy: were seeing a 3-5s tail for streaming completions in us-west-2. p99 > our rollback threshold. looks concentrated on smaller batch sizes.
Priya: confirming traces. nvlink stall on a tiny subset of hosts -> request retries amplify the tail. could mitigate with a routing pin to older runtime on those hosts.
Diego: autopilot would kick if we left it. recommend lock + scoped pin to affected pool, run a targeted kernel rollback there, then unpin.
deploy-bot: autopilot rollback window active for r=2026.06.10-0300. To suppress automatic rollback set `--safety-mutex locked`. Scoped actions: `traffic-pin --pool <pool> --version <v>` or `route-exclude --hosts <hostlist>`
Sam: locking safety-mutex for 45m now. will pin the affected pool (embed-proc-usw2) back to v2.8.9 while we roll kernel-fix to those hosts.
Priya: run commands: ``traffic-pin --pool=embed-proc-usw2 --version=v2.8.9 --reason=\"nvlink-stall-mitigation\"`` and ``route-exclude --hosts=usw2-a12,usw2-a13``
ops-bot: executed `traffic-pin` for embed-proc-usw2 -> v2.8.9. Pin TTL 2h. `route-exclude` applied to usw2-a12, usw2-a13 for new traffic.
Maya: product note ready. short customer blurb drafted: \"We're investigating intermittent elevated latency for streaming responses in US-West. We've temporarily routed affected traffic to a stable runtime and are deploying a targeted fix. No user data affected.\" link to note: https://company.docs/release-notes/2026-06-10-streaming-latency
Diego: rolling kernel fix to the two hosts now: `ops run kernel-rollback --hosts=usw2-a12,usw2-a13 --image=kernel-stable-4`
Priya: monitoring: p99 on pinned pool dropped to baseline within 3 mins. overall region p99 still elevated by ~5% due to retries but trending down.
Sam: consensus: no global rollback. keep mutex locked until kernel fix verified (30m after kernel rollout). add postmortem item to improve nvlink health alerting.
deploy-bot: noted. safety-mutex locked by Sam until 1732103810. autopilot suppressed until then. manual rollback permitted.
Diego: added runbook snippet to release: 1) safety-mutex lock; 2) scoped traffic-pin + host exclude; 3) kernel rollback to affected hosts; 4) monitor 30m then unpin; 5) follow-up: nvlink probe + alert tuning.
Sam: thanks all. I'll unpin and re-enable autopilot if stable after monitoring window. :thumbsup:
